about_the_game:
Slingbox is a minimalist, physics-based 2D platformer about precision, flow, and speed. Dash, swing, and launch your way through clean, abstract worlds where momentum is everything.

Every second counts — shave down your times, earn medals, and chase perfection across a short but tightly designed speedrunning experience.

Features

  • ⚡ Momentum-Driven Movement – Master two simple mechanics: a fast directional dash and a springy rope that slings you forward.

  • 🎯 Precision & Flow – Levels are designed to test skill and reward mastery. Every input matters.

  • 🌀 5 Distinct Worlds – Each world introduces new mechanics and challenges, keeping the experience fresh.

  • ⏱️ Race Against the Clock – Beat levels as quickly as possible, earn medals, and compete for your fastest runs.

  • ✨ Minimalist Style – Clean geometry, sharp colors, and dynamic shadows keep the focus on pure gameplay.

Race against the clock, earn medals, and master 5 unique worlds!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU or ARMv8
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support, Direct3D 12 (12_0 feature level) support (Windows)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
